purpose: Track exact PEP primary mathematics volumes and prevent legacy or generic current-series pages from being mistaken for verified 12th-series semester sequences.

current_series.launch_evidence: PEP states that the 12th series began use in starting grades from autumn 2024.
current_series.volume_policy: A volume is not fully verified until edition identity plus an official TOC and sufficient volume metadata are captured.
current_series.rollout_rule: Do not infer mathematics year-by-year rollout from notices for other subjects.
current_series.context_rule: A current PEP page without a volume TOC can confirm current-series activity but cannot verify grade/semester sequence.

current_companion_evidence.evidence: Official PEP page states the Grade 1 upper oral-calculation workbook is synchronized by lesson period with the new textbook.
current_companion_evidence.limit: No textbook TOC or ISBN exposed.
